# Living at Reflections

> > Luxury residential treatment center in the San Francisco Bay Area specializing in dual-diagnosis care, OCD treatment, and evidence-based therapies including DBT.

Living at Reflections offers comprehensive mental health and addiction treatment programs with a holistic, trauma-informed approach. The facility provides specialized care for conditions including Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder, anxiety disorders, and co-occurring disorders, accepting major insurance providers throughout California.

## Key Topics

- Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- Dual-diagnosis treatment
- Evidence-based therapy
- Trauma-informed care
- Luxury residential rehab
- Anxiety treatment
- Addiction recovery
- Holistic treatment approach
- Family programs
- Relapse prevention
- Bay Area treatment facilities
- Insurance verification (Aetna, Anthem, BCBS, Cigna, United Healthcare, Magellan, Medi-Cal)
